description:
Ben & Jerry's Dough-ble Chocolate Cookie Dough Twist is a flavour that came out last year, one to excite the cookie dough lovers but ultimately failed on......the cookie dough!
Bad reviews everywhere, claims of poor cookie dough and not enough it meant this flavour was split right down the middle. 50% loved it, 50% didn't. 

After making the Rain Dough Cookie Dough Twist, It was time to dig out the chocolate version and make that....only better!

So I decided to try and get closer to Ben & Jerry's ice cream method by using the ingredients I think they used, this didn't include tradiitional milk, instead condensed milk. 

So if you want to have a go at making this, I think you should as it's head and shoulders above theirs, this is what you'll need:

------------------------------------------------------

Ice Cream Base:
250g Double/Heavy Cream
300g Water
40g Sugar
0.7g Locust Bean Gum (optional)
0.45g Guar Gum (optional)
65g Dextrose (if you don't have, use a total of 110g sugar)
50g Cocoa powder (12% fat)
100g Condensed milk
2 Egg Yolks
50g Chocolate chips (56% cocoa)

The Cookie Dough Core:
60g Unsalted Butter at room temperature
15g Sugar
55g Brown Sugar
5g Salt
30ml Milk
15g Golden Syrup/Corn Syrup
5g Vanilla Extract
70-90g All-purpose/Plain Flour  (baked at 350°F/180°C for 10 minutes and cooled completely)
60g Semi-sweet Chocolate chips
50g Cocoa powder (12% Fat)

------------------------------------------------

The base is reasonable thick but don't worry, it'll churn fine. Overall, I was super happy with the resulting combo. Great flavour with the De Zaan cocoa powder, Barima 56% Chocolate Chips were perfect, the cookie dough isn't powdery and has the perfect texture. 
Defiantely give this one a go, you won't regret it.
